a.lede: A little less than two years ago, Elon Musk stood onstage at the Conservative Political Action Conference, sunglasses on, black MAGA hat perched atop his head, wielding a chainsaw. Last night, Musk called in to The New York Times DealBook Summit and distanced himself from President Donald Trump's movement. "I think I'm ideologically quite moderate. […]
a.title: Oh, Elon Musk is ‘moderate’ now, is he?

b.lede: During his appearance Wednesday at The New York Times' DealBook Summit, Elon Musk said that he wasn't sure what the term "MAGA" meant and also commented that he felt "pretty foolish" for having spent so much money during the U.S. midterms.
b.title: Elon Musk says: ‘I’m not MAGA’
